tldr: Leo rising: warm, expressive, and visibly alive when the heart is engaged.
body: With Leo rising, you meet life through presence, creativity, and the need to express what is unmistakably yours. Your path asks you to be seen without turning visibility into a constant performance review.
approach: Leads with warmth, creates atmosphere, and brings confidence into first contact.
shadow: Drama, pride, or confusing attention with genuine recognition.
note: Authored from Marie Satori Big Three and sign material.
